products.name: Implement & Manage CIS Benchmarks for macOS Devices for Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement and continuously manage CIS Benchmarks for macOS in Microsoft Intune — build the hardened Level 1/Level 2 baseline via settings catalog, custom profiles, and shell scripts, prove compliance, and run a documented update process every time CIS publishes a new version. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Harden every macOS device to the CIS Benchmark — and keep it that way as the benchmark evolves

Security and audit teams increasingly require Macs to meet the CIS Benchmarks, but hardening macOS by hand is painful: dozens of controls split across configuration profiles, settings the GUI can't reach (so you need custom .mobileconfig payloads and shell scripts), Level 1 vs Level 2 decisions, and a benchmark that gets revised regularly so your baseline silently drifts out of compliance. This solution gives you a repeatable way to implement and then continuously manage CIS Benchmarks for macOS in Microsoft Intune — build the hardened baseline as Intune policy, prove compliance, and run a documented update process every time CIS publishes a new version.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what the CIS Benchmarks for macOS are, Level 1 vs Level 2, how the controls map to Intune (settings catalog, custom configuration profiles using .mobileconfig, and macOS shell scripts) versus what Apple/Intune can enforce natively, the compliance/reporting model, and the benchmark-version maintenance lifecycle.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, supported macOS version, Apple MDM push (APNs) certificate, enrollment, device groups, the official CIS Benchmark source, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide (net-new) — exact, ordered steps: stage the benchmark, build the Level 1 (and optional Level 2) configuration in Intune via settings catalog, custom profiles, and shell scripts, handle known break-glass exceptions, assign to a pilot, validate compliance, then expand fleet-wide.
  • Maintenance & Update Guide — a repeatable process for when CIS releases a new macOS benchmark version: obtain the new version, diff it against your live baseline, assess and approve changes, update the Intune policies/profiles/scripts in a controlled change, re-validate, and record the version you are on.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — CIS-readiness discovery, per-device CIS-compliance validation, a fleet CIS posture and drift report, safe remediation of drifted settings, and a benchmark-version comparison helper that diffs a new CIS export against your current baseline.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Mac hardened to the CIS Benchmark and provably compliant — with a documented update lifecycle that keeps the baseline current each time CIS revises it, instead of silently drifting — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, maintenance & updates, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CISMAC-Compare-BenchmarkVersion.ps1 — diff a NEW CIS macOS benchmark export against the current live baseline
    • CISMAC-Discovery.ps1 — tenant/device CIS-Benchmark readiness for macOS (management plane, Graph)
    • CISMAC-Remediation.ps1 — safely reapply/repair a drifted CIS macOS baseline (management plane, Graph)
    • CISMAC-Report.ps1 — fleet CIS posture + drift via Microsoft Graph (Intune macOS config + scripts)
    • CISMAC-Validation.ps1 — per-device CIS-compliance check for a Mac (management plane, Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
